question: Where can I get the list of grid connection requests in France, with project, technology, capacity (MW), connection node, status and date?

answer.summary: No public list of individual connection requests was found in the sources checked. Enedis publishes quarterly aggregates by department, technology and power band since 2020. Its queue field sums to 32,789 on 2026-09-30 (about 32.8 GW if the field is in MW; the schema does not state the unit). Caparéseau gives queue power per substation, ODRE regional totals and EDF SEI figures for Corsica and overseas territories. The CRE procedure describes how distributors send project and client names to RTE.
main_caveats: The checked datasets give aggregates. None lists a project name, a node, a status or an event date per request.
Enedis counts only its own network; RTE, local distributors and storage or consumption queues need other sources.
'In development' differs by operator: RTE counts queue entry or accepted technical proposals, Enedis counts requests qualified complete.
The Enedis power unit is not declared in the schema (MW consistent); ODRE has one annual date.
Caparéseau queue power covers S3REnR generation only; summing substations was not reconciled across RTE and distributor views.
answer.confidence_reason: Enedis, ODRE, Caparéseau and EDF datasets were queried and CRE's procedure read; the absence of a request list rests on these pages, not on a registry statement.

attributes.note: No checked source lists individual connection requests. The documented datasets aggregate by department, region, substation or technology.
attributes.gap_note: Enedis and EDF Data Fair sets, ODRE, Caparéseau and RTE pages were opened; CRE's procedure shows project and client names are only passed from distributors to RTE (from July 2027).

attributes.note: Technology exists only as an aggregate dimension (seven classes at Enedis; sectors at ODRE and EDF).
Enedis gives aggregates by department and power band (32,789 on 2026-09-30; MW inferred). Caparéseau gives totals per substation and ODRE by region.
attributes.gap_note: No requested capacity per request; the Enedis unit is not declared.

attributes.note: Caparéseau gives queue power per substation (3,116 mainland; 2,279 above zero), not per request; requested and assigned node are not distinguished.
attributes.gap_note: No mapping from individual requests to nodes was found in the checked datasets.

attributes.note: Enedis separates in queue, entered and left per quarter; ODRE gives each operator's definition; no status per request.
attributes.gap_note: No per-request status or queue position.

attributes.note: Only quarter-end dates (Enedis) or 31/12/2024 (ODRE) for aggregates; no application, acceptance or decision date per request.
attributes.gap_note: The checked datasets give no dates for individual events.
The latest checked data are aggregates. No current request-level dataset was found.

attributes.note: Enedis gives 27 quarter-end values from 2020-03-31 (12,536 to 32,789 in queue); ODRE has one date and Caparéseau none.
attributes.gap_note: No history of individual requests; RTE and ELD history was not found.

attributes.note: Enedis and EDF SEI state quarterly; ODRE is annual; Caparéseau has no stated schedule.
attributes.gap_note: No schedule for Caparéseau or for RTE queue figures.
